newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Fifteen drown in Bangladesh boat capsize.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen drown in Bangladesh boat capsize.

text.p: At least 15 people drowned when a boat capsized in the Meghna river near Narsingdi industrial town, 60 km (40 miles) from the Bangladesh capital Dhaka, state television said on Tuesday night.
It said the boat carrying at least 40 people sank on Monday evening. Twenty-five people swam ashore and rescuers retrieved 15 bodies on Tuesday.
No other details were immediately available.
